notes.title: Clockwise - Demo Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581308/c638e72a7b482a2cb65ed49cec3749e490e40a40.png[/img]

Hey there,

as announced earlier already i am happy to present you the opportunity to download a full gameplay demo of "Clockwise". It contains the same gameplay experience as the full game, but can only be played until a certain point of the game according to its "in-game-time".
Please keep in mind that even though you already get a pretty good impression and feeling of how the game is probably going to be like for you, it remains a demo. It is not meant to give you the complete impression of the game... so it is common that especially in the beginning of a horrorgame, you can not expect the biggest scares and the deepest atmosphere. 

If you want to figure out, whether the game is something for you and if you might like the complete version, consider downloading the demo. Any feedback is helpful in any way... feel free to leave a comment or mail me directly.

I hope you will like it.

cheers,
pheenix93

Link to the main store page, where you can find the download-button: https://store.steampowered.com/app/581380/Clockwise/

notes.title: Clockwise - version 1.5 available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28581308/c638e72a7b482a2cb65ed49cec3749e490e40a40.png[/img]

Hey there!,

it has been a while since there was a major update to this game, but however... here we go! Coming with a bunch of nice features and additional content.  I had a lot of time to collect all the feedback that was there... if it was via messages or videos on all the different platforms. I noticed some -now obvious- flaws that the game had and tried to eliminate them ... at least partially. 

Please see the changelog for further info! I hope you will enjoy the made changes.

Changelog:
[list][*]Completely new (changing) area added with additional puzzles and more content
[*]Already solved puzzles or rooms do not need to be solved again in order to proceed
[/list]
And in case you are not understanding any english... that is no problem. The main game is available in English, Korean, German and Russian.  Currently I am also working on a demo release on Steam... so that is hopefully going to follow soon.

I hope you will like it!

Cheers,
pheenix93

notes.title: Version 1.4 released - play now on korean!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581308/c638e72a7b482a2cb65ed49cec3749e490e40a40.png[/img][h1][b]Version 1.4 released[/b][/h1] 
[b]*korean language added*[/b] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581308/5a9faa02e09dee25795bd1d9682f1b4f34dc9f1b.png[/img]

It has been a while since the last update on this project. However i was working on this in the beginning of 2019 and it was just waiting for release. With this update I am bringing a major change to the game - a new language: Korean!

I know that there are a lot of asian players out there that have difficulties finding games in their language - so this had to be done.

It has been really difficult for me as  a non-korean person to change all of the games' contents to a completely foreign language, not even being able to write it. With the help of my publishers partners i can bring this to you though.

Changelog (in comparison to v 1.1.3):
[list]
[*] Fix, where even upon selecting the correct language you ended up playing on english
[*] Added Korean as a new fully functional language (decals, menu, text,...)
[*] other minor adjustments
[/list]

Thanks and enjoy!
[i]- pheenix93[/i]

notes.title: Update to version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After collecting the first feedbacks i am happy to announce the first major update to the game. It is going to go live in the next hour.

It will improve overall performance quite a bit and add a selection on the menu that will help you set the "time" in game to a certain value. That way you dont have to start all over again if you don't want to play the whole game at once. This should come in handy. I hope it is working flawlessly. So far i did not encounter any issues with it... but still be aware that there is a general risk by using it. It can be found under "options":

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28581308/3e43973b43e1629f0f16321424d1f9bed8f8ec4d.jpg[/img]

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Added Clock to menu for choosing a different starting round
[*]Reworked moving chair
[*]New achievement added
[/list]
Cheers, pheenix

notes.title: Clockwise Release
notes.notes:
Hello there everyone,

As you see the release of Clockwise is right around the corner.
For the release there are a few things you may want to know:

[list]
    [*]It is going to be a full release (no demo, alpha, beta,...) - v1.0
    [*]Languages from the start will be Russian, German and of course English
    [*]For trading cards i am aiming to implement them asap. Most likely not directly on release.
[/list]

I want to thank again for the support and I hope everyone will like the game. And if not... give constructive feedback. Although I prefer option number one. :)

If there are any questions left, feel free to ask in the community hub. 

,pheenix
